title: Spring Batch & Scheduling
intro: Spring Batch interview questions cover the batch-processing framework that powers reconciliation, ETL and reporting jobs in every regulated Java backend — the Job/Step/Tasklet/Chunk model, ItemReader/Processor/Writer, restart and skip logic, partitioning and parallel steps, JobRepository internals, and the integration patterns that show up in finance and telco interviews. Each answer leads with the framework concept, then the operational concern interviewers really want to hear.
